# Tasks

## 1. Parsing

- [ ] 1.1 A plain task
- [~] 1.2 A task marked in progress
- []  1.3 Empty brackets
- [ ]
- [ ] 1.4 A parent
  - [ ] 1.4.1 Its child
- [ ] 2.5 A number from another group
- [ ] 1.1 The same number again

```markdown
- [ ] 1.9 A checkbox inside a fence
```

## 2. Order

- [ ] 2.1 Depends on a later task, depends on 2.2
- [ ] 2.2 After 9.9, which does not exist
1) [x] 2.3 An ordered-list marker

## Notes

- [ ] Something unnumbered
